description: Run a bounded same-host HTML crawl seeded from the start URL and same-host sitemap URLs. Defaults to 50 attempted URLs and accepts up to 200. Preserves trailing slashes when requesting URLs, reads robots.txt first, applies its rules and crawl-delay, separates non-HTML sitemap resources, and never renders JavaScript or follows links to other hosts. Reports known queued URL counts, not sitewide coverage.

maxPages.description: Maximum URL fetch attempts, including non-HTML sitemap resources and URL variants that redirect to an already seen page.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS start URL.

name: edgeo_crawl_site
title: Crawl and audit a public site
